NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE I Rezoning Attachment
3664 North Lincoln Avenue
From BI-1 to B2-5

The Property
The subject property is improved with a one-story commercial building. The surrounding area is comprised

of assorted zoning districts including B1-1, B1-2, M1-2, and large areas of varying R-districts. The area is
improved with buildings comprised of residential and commercial uses. The property is also a Transit Served
Location per the Transit Oriented Provisions of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, Section 17-10-0102-B (1),
as it is located within 315 feet of the Addison Brown Line CTA Station Entrance.*

The Project
The Applicant proposes to improve the property by constructing a five-story, mixed-use building with a 1,700

square foot ground floor commercial space and 16 residential dwelling units above the ground floor. Six
automobile parking spaces and 17 bicycle parking spaces will be provided. The proposed zoning height of
the building will be 60 feet. To allow the proposed development, the Applicant seeks a zoning change for
the subject property from a B1-1 Neighborhood Shopping District to a B2-5 Neighborhood Mixed-Use
District. The Applicant is filing a Type | rezoning application and is seeking all relief as needed, as allowed
by the Chicago Zoning Code, for the attached plans, including: 1) a variation under 17-13-1003-Q and 17-
13-1101-A to reduce by 25% the required transparent window area required for the building fagades along
North Lincoln Avenue and West Waveland Avenue; 2) a variation under section 17-13-1101-D to reduce the
required number of loading berths from one to zero; 3) a variation under sections 17-13-1003-EE and 17-13-
1101-A to reduce the required automobile parking spaces from the required eight spaces to six spaces; 4) a
variation to reduce the rear-yard setback from the required 30 feet to two feet under 17-13-1101-B; 5) a
variation under sections 17-13-1101-A, 17-13-1101-B, and 17-13-1003-P to allow a building facade setback
along the sidewalk to be greater than five feet along West Waveland Avenue (proposed entrance setback of
seven feet); and 6) a variation under 17-13-1003-L to increase the maximum building height by 5.5 feet
(10%) to 60.5 feet; 7) a variation under 17-13-1101-B to reduce the setback for the stairwell override; and 8)
a variation under 17-13-1101-B to reduce the setback for the elevator override.

17-3-0308 Specific Criteria for Transit Served Locations Requirements
1. The project complies with the applicable standards of Section 17-10-0102-B:

RESPONSE: The project complies with Section 17-10-0102-B as the property is a Transit Served
Location within 315 feet of the Addison Brown Line CTA Station Entrance. The proposed development
does not include more than 50% of the otherwise required parking.

2. The project complies with the standards and regulations of Section 17-3-0504, except paragraph H if the
project is not located along a pedestrian street and except paragraph C if the land use is designated in a non-
commercial use group, pertaining to pedestrian streets and pedestrian retail streets, even if the project is not
located along a pedestrian street or a pedestrian retail street:

RESPONSE: The project is along a pedestrian street and substantially complies with Section 17-3-0504

because:

e Building Location: Other than the requested two-foot variation to building location standards to
accommodate for the depth of the residential entry, the front fagade faces West Waveland Avenue, and
the design complies with sections (2)(a)-(c) as the entrance size is within the required parameters;

e Transparency: The Applicant will provide transparent windows and will seek an optional relief
through the Type 1 rezoning application provision of 17-13-0303-D and 17-13-1003-Q to reduce
transparency;

¢ Doors and Entrances: The building’s front doors will face West Waveland Avenue, a non-pedestrian
street;

© Off-Street Parking: Six on-site automobile parking spaces will be provided;

* A set of plans, including a site plan showing the TSL distances to CTA Rail Station is attached.

¢ Parking Location: On-site parking will be enclosed and in the rear; and
© = Drivewavs and Vehicle Access: The Applicant will provide access to the parking garage from the
rear alley.

3. The project complies with the general goals set forth in the Transit Friendly Development Guide: Station Area
Typology, and any other station-specific plans, designs or guidelines adopted by the Chicago Plan
Commission:

RESPONSE: The property is identified under the Transit Friendly Guide station topography as an Urban
Neighborhood (UN), which calls for infill projects and that encourage transit use such as new multifamily
buildings and local retai] developments adjacent to transit stations.

4. Residential building projects shall not have a number of parking spaces in excess of 50% of the Minimum
Automobile Parking Ratio for the applicable district listed in Section 17-30-0207 with any fractional result
rounded up to the next higher whole number, unless additional parking spaces are approved as
an administrative adjustment under the provisions of Section 17-13-1003-EE; and

RESPONSE: The project does not have parking in excess of 50%. The Applicant is seeking to reduce
parking from eight required (50%) to six spaces under the provisions of 17-13-1003-EE.

5. The project complies with the Travel Demand Study and Management Plan rules of the Chicago Department
of Transportation.
RESPONSE: The project will comply with applicable Travel Demand Study and Management Plan
tules promulgated by the Chicago Department of Transportation.
